body:
Build a deterministic, zero-dependency statistical evaluation and benchmark framework in evals/ comparing Straight Antigravity (agy solo serial, agy single-pool fan-out, agy same-model self-review, agy prompt-only rail instructions) against Antigravity + Booster (agb quota-pool-aware DAG scheduler, cross-family prosecutor + 4-specialist review fleet, PreToolUse policy guard + adlc rails-guard + adlc hollow-test + adlc flail-detector):
1. Create evals/stats.mjs implementing seeded PRNG (mulberry32), descriptive statistics (mean, sd, median, p90, p95, iqr), bootstrapCI (95% CI, B=2000), cohensD, mannWhitneyU (two-sided normal-approximated p-value), twoProportionZTest, wilsonScoreInterval, and pairedRatioSummary.
2. Create evals/scenarios.mjs implementing 4 empirically calibrated scenarios (N=100 paired runs per scenario, grounded in docs/calibration/probes-2026-06-11.md and probes-2026-07-14.md): Perf-1 (8-ticket feature DAG), Perf-2 (16-ticket scale refactoring under pool rate limits), Acc-1 (500-defect cross-model prosecution vs. same-model self-review corpus), and Acc-2 (300-hazard mechanical safety gate evaluation).
3. Create evals/runner.mjs (and npm run eval script) that executes the 4 scenarios plus live mechanical probes of PreToolUse rail blocking and agy 1.4.x validator output parsing, verifies all statistical invariants, and writes docs/benchmarks/marketplace-eval-report.md.
4. Add unit and statistical invariant tests in test/evals.test.mjs.

Acceptance Criteria:
- `node --test test/evals.test.mjs` exits 0.
- `node evals/runner.mjs --write-report docs/benchmarks/marketplace-eval-report.md` exits 0.
title: Reproducible statistical evaluation & benchmark suite comparing Antigravity + Booster against straight Antigravity
